content.text: The Real Reason This Problem Exists

The underlying issue is that existing payment infrastructure is based on centralized systems that rely on geographic location and access to specific platforms like Stripe, which is not available in West Africa. This creates a barrier for creators who want to sell digital products internationally, forcing them to rely on expensive and unreliable workarounds or compromise their sovereignty by using platforms that charge high fees and provide limited control.
Why the Obvious Fixes Do Not Work

Obvious fixes such as using alternative payment processors or relying on local banks are not viable solutions due to high fees, limited coverage, and lack of scalability. Moreover, these alternatives often require significant resources and expertise, making them inaccessible to many creators. The current system is designed to keep creators tied to centralized platforms, limiting their ability to innovate and grow their businesses.
The Infrastructure That Solves It at the Base Layer

The solution lies in infrastructure that is decentralized, scalable, and accessible to creators in West Africa. By utilizing blockchain-based payment systems like NOWPayments, creators can receive payments in their local currencies without relying on centralized platforms. Cloudflare infrastructure provides a secure and reliable base layer for deploying sovereign digital commerce stacks, enabling creators to build, deploy, and scale their businesses without compromise.
Blockchain-based payment systems like NOWPayments provide a decentralized and accessible solution for receiving payments in local currencies.
How to Implement the Solution Today

To implement the solution today, creators can start by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack using the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. By following the checklist below, creators can quickly and easily set up their own payment infrastructure and start selling digital products internationally.
What Your Store Looks Like After the Fix

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Cloudflare infrastructure provides a secure and reliable base layer for deploying sovereign digital commerce stacks.

To learn more about the Complete Builder Kit and other products, visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
